title: General Education Requirement (GER)
description: A general education course chosen by the student from the School of Computing and Information's requirement areas.
notes: Pitt: GER slots in the Sample Plan of Study (note 1); one course must satisfy the Diversity Requirement.

title: Elective
description: A free elective chosen by the student.
notes: Pitt: free elective; may count toward a minor or certificate (note 2).

title: CS Upper-Level Elective
description: An upper-level computer science course (numbered 1500 or higher) chosen by the student.

title: CS Upper-Level Elective or Elective
description: An upper-level computer science course, or a free elective.
notes: Pitt: a seventh upper-level elective counts toward departmental honors (note 4).

title: Capstone Experience
description: A capstone experience: an approved internship, directed research project, or team software project course, or two co-op rotations.
notes: Choice slot: Pitt's CS 1900, CS 1906, CS 1950, or CS 1980. Official descriptions (except CS 1906, which has none) are in data/raw/pitt/courses/.
